theme: The girls come to you today.
greeting: The four girls come to you and Mike at the three o'clock pickup, Dan, and the week at the Orlando villa begins tonight. The morning until then is quiet and yours.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV is the last six-seater
needsAttention.detail: A p1 on the Mike + Dan board, overdue since the 14th. Once the Pathfinder heads south in October, a full-size SUV out of Portland is the girls' only six-seater at Christmas, and that holiday inventory sells out early. A refundable hold costs nothing.

needsAttention.title: Six Disney tickets still unbought
needsAttention.detail: The one open item left for the Sept 26-27 Orlando trip: six park tickets. Worth checking whether the ticket type needs park reservations and whether a Magic Kingdom Halloween party falls that night, since it changes the plan.

needsAttention.title: Claire's St. Pete appointment at 10:20
needsAttention.detail: On the calendar for tomorrow morning in St. Pete, which sits against the Orlando villa week starting tonight; worth deciding tonight how the morning gets covered.
